title: The Anatomy of Censorship and Propaganda: Evidence from Russian Wikipedias
title_zh: 审查与宣传的剖析：来自俄语维基百科的证据
authors: Ekaterina Zhuravskaya, Ulrich Matter, Ruben Durante, Vladimir Avetian
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Authoritarian regimes shape citizens’ knowledge and beliefs through censorship and propaganda. We study which narratives they suppress and promote using a rare natural experiment: Ruwiki, created in 2023 by cloning Russian-language Wikipedia and selectively rewriting its 1.9 million articles under regime-aligned editorial control. We compare the two platforms twenty months after the fork, using within-Wikipedia changes as a placebo benchmark. We find that Ruwiki’s editing patterns resemble professional rather than volunteer-driven content production. An LLM-based comparison and machine-learning analyses of text deletions and insertions reveal a coherent ideology organized around three pillars: Russia’s image vis-àvis the rest of the world, domestic politics, and culture. The resulting narratives legitimize Russia’s past and present acts of aggression, suppress accounts of domestic opposition and human-rights violations, and promote traditional values. Culture’s centrality reveals how authoritarian information control penetrates domains far beyond formal politics, including morality, gender, family life, law, and psychology. Article deletions are rare and confined to topics that are difficult to reframe, while editing is broad, consistent with a preference for reframing existing content rather than leaving unanswered queries: 27% of articles undergo at least some change, 2.8% are heavily edited, and only 0.14% are deleted. Rewriting sensitive topics reduces readability, suggesting that ideological control is costly. An external benchmark using official high-school history textbooks confirms that Ruwiki’s revisions move articles on modern history toward state-sanctioned narratives. The results show how authoritarian information control constructs a regime-aligned account of the world and Russia’s place in it.
abstract_zh: 威权政权通过审查和宣传塑造公民的知识与信念。我们利用一项罕见的自然实验——Ruwiki（2023年通过克隆俄语维基百科并在亲政权编辑控制下选择性重写其190万篇文章创建而成）——研究其压制和推广的叙事。在分叉二十个月后，我们以维基百科内部变化作为安慰剂基准，对两个平台进行比较。研究发现，Ruwiki的编辑模式更接近专业内容生产而非志愿者驱动。基于大语言模型的比较以及对文本删除和插入的机器学习分析揭示了一套围绕三大支柱构建的连贯意识形态：俄罗斯相对于世界其他地区的形象、国内政治以及文化。由此产生的叙事将俄罗斯过去和现在的侵略行为合法化，压制国内反对派和人权侵犯的报道，并推广传统价值观。文化的核心地位揭示了威权信息控制如何渗透到远超正式政治领域的范畴，包括道德、性别、家庭生活、法律和心理学。文章删除极为罕见，仅限于难以重新框架化的主题；而编辑则广泛存在，这与偏好重新框架现有内容而非留下未解答疑问的倾向一致：27%的文章经历了至少某种程度的修改，2.8%被大幅编辑，仅0.14%被删除。对敏感话题的重写降低了可读性，表明意识形态控制代价高昂。使用官方高中历史教科书作为外部基准证实，Ruwiki的修订将现代史相关文章推向国家认可的叙事。研究结果展示了威权信息控制如何构建一套符合政权立场的世界叙事及俄罗斯在其中地位的图景。

title: Expanding the Landscape of Cross-Border Flow Restrictions: Modern Tools and Historical Perspectives
title_zh: 拓展跨境资金流动限制的格局：现代工具与历史视角
authors: Katharina Bergant & Andres Fernandez & Mr. Ken Teoh & Martin Uribe
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Employing large language models to analyze official documents, we construct a comprehensive record of daily changes in de jure restrictions on cross-border flows worldwide since the 1950s. Our analysis uncovers the wide array of instruments used to regulate cross-border financial flows over the past seven decades, leveraging the fine granularity of the new measures to characterize cross-country and time-series variation across eight categories of restrictions —- distinguishing by flow, direction, instrument type, intensity, and overall policy stance. We exploit the high frequency nature of the new data to document novel patterns in the use of these restrictions, as well as their relationship to crises and political economy determinants.
abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型分析官方文件，我们构建了自20世纪50年代以来全球跨境流动法律限制每日变化的综合记录。通过新措施的高粒度特性，我们揭示了过去七十年间用于监管跨境资金流动的广泛工具组合，从八个限制类别（按流动类型、方向、工具种类、强度及整体政策立场区分）刻画了跨国与时间序列的差异。借助新数据的高频特征，我们记录了这些限制使用的新模式，及其与危机和政治经济决定因素之间的关联。

title: Migration and the Making of the English Middle Class
title_zh: 移民与英国中产阶级的形成
official: 官方在线 2026-01-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When do people identify with their class? Evidence from social psychology shows that individuals are more likely to identify with a group if they are similar to its members. We study early 20th century Britain and show that regional cultural heterogeneity combined with internal migration influenced class identity. We develop and validate a measure of class identity using naming decisions. Exploiting within-household variation, we show that migration patterns that increased the local share of culturally-distant workers reduced working class identification. Where migration increased the cultural distance of the working class, workers were less likely to join unions, voters were less likely to support the nascent Labour Party, and parliamentary candidates were less likely to target working class voters. By 1911, slower in-migration and rising local population growth reduced working class distance in urban areas, which also became strongholds of support for Labour. Migration alters social identity and creates political cleavages.
abstract_zh: 人们何时会认同自己的阶级？社会心理学证据表明，个体与群体成员相似度越高，越可能产生群体认同。本研究以20世纪初的英国为对象，揭示区域文化异质性与内部迁移共同塑造了阶级认同。我们通过命名决策开发并验证了阶级认同的测量指标。利用家庭内部差异分析发现，增加本地文化疏离型工人比例的迁移模式会削弱工人阶级认同。当迁移加剧工人阶级文化距离时，工人加入工会的意愿降低，选民对新兴工党的支持率下降，议会候选人针对工人阶级选民的竞选策略也相应减少。至1911年，缓慢的迁入增长与本地人口上升缩小了城市地区的工人阶级文化距离，这些区域随之成为工党票仓。迁移重塑社会认同，并催生政治分野。
